title: Planning a holiday
instructions: Burak ve Selin yaz tatili planlıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; yer, süre, ulaşım ve konaklama kararlarını takip et.

script.speaker: burak
script.text: Selin, where do you want to go this summer?

script.speaker: selin
script.text: I'd like to go somewhere with beaches. What about Spain?

script.speaker: burak
script.text: We went to Spain two years ago. What about Croatia? I saw some photos. It looks amazing.

script.speaker: selin
script.text: Croatia sounds good. How long can we go for?

script.speaker: burak
script.text: I have ten days off in August.

script.speaker: selin
script.text: I only have a week. So let's go for seven days.

script.speaker: burak
script.text: OK. Shall we fly or drive?

script.speaker: selin
script.text: Driving is too far. It's more than twenty hours. Let's fly to Split.

script.speaker: burak
script.text: And where shall we stay? A hotel?

script.speaker: selin
script.text: Hotels are expensive in August. Let's rent a small apartment. We can cook some meals.

script.speaker: burak
script.text: Good idea. I can look at apartments tonight.

script.speaker: selin
script.text: And I can check the flight prices.

questions.prompt: Why don't they go to Spain?
options: They went there two years ago.
questions.evidence: We went to Spain two years ago.

questions.feedback: Burak'ın on günü var ama Selin'in sadece bir haftası; yedi gün gidecekler.
questions.evidence: So let's go for seven days.

questions.prompt: How are they going to travel?
Where are they going to stay?
questions.feedback: Otel ağustosta pahalı; küçük bir daire kiralayacaklar.
